clue.text: People in the same company shifting blame among countries

indicators.note: the scrambled word sits among the letters of the countries word, so it is placed within it

parts.note: states are countries or nations

indicators.note: shifting tells us the letters of blame move into a new order

explanation.surface: An office story: colleagues moving the blame around between nations.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shifting' turns BLAME into ABLEM, which goes 'among' STATES.
explanation.definitionFit: Stablemates are horses, or by extension people, belonging to the same owner or organisation.

clue.text: Group of three attempt to kidnap popular Italian

indicators.note: to kidnap is to seize and hold, so the attempt word holds the other pieces inside it

parts.note: an attempt is a try
popular things are in
It is short for Italian vermouth, as in gin and It

explanation.surface: Three conspirators try to abduct a well-liked Italian.
explanation.walkthrough: IT for Italian comes from gin and It, Italian vermouth.
explanation.definitionFit: A trinity is any set of three, most famously the Christian Godhead.

clue.text: Graduate teacher snaffles damaged carafe, showing no shame

indicators.note: to snaffle is to grab and take in, so the qualification letters enclose the next piece

parts.note: a BEd is a Bachelor of Education, a graduate teaching degree

indicators.note: damaged signals the letters of carafe are knocked into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A trained teacher pockets a broken wine jug and is brazen about it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Graduate teacher' is a BEd, a Bachelor of Education degree, not a person; 'snaffles' puts AREFAC, from 'damaged' carafe, inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Barefaced behaviour is open and shameless, without any attempt at disguise.

clue.text: Team schemer regularly sees host

indicators.note: regularly here means taking every other letter, starting from the second

explanation.surface: A plotter in the team keeps meeting the host.
explanation.walkthrough: The even letters of TEAM SCHEMER give the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: An emcee, from MC, is a master of ceremonies who presents an event.

clue.text: Get rid of sailor from Poland lacking origin

parts.note: AB is an able-bodied seaman

indicators.note: lacking its origin means the word's opening letter is cut off

parts.note: something from Poland is Polish

explanation.surface: An order to dismiss a Polish sailor who has no roots.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lacking origin' removes the P from POLISH.
explanation.definitionFit: To abolish something is to do away with it formally, such as a law or custom.

clue.text: English politician has level that's comparatively vacuous

parts.note: an MP is a Member of Parliament
a tier is a level or layer

explanation.surface: A jibe that an English MP at a certain rank is rather empty-headed.
explanation.definitionFit: Comparative of a word meaning vacant or without content, so more vacuous.

clue.text: Vehicle on burning heap full of black material

indicators.note: in a down clue, on means the vehicle sits above what follows

parts.note: a car is a vehicle

indicators.note: full of means the heap contains the next letter inside it

parts.note: a bonfire is a heap of material set alight
B is the pencil-grade abbreviation for black

explanation.surface: A car dumped on a blazing pile packed with something dark.
explanation.definitionFit: Carbon fibre is a strong lightweight composite used in cars and sports gear.

clue.text: Instrument of French iniquity

parts.note: de is the French word for of
vice is wickedness or iniquity

explanation.surface: A French tool for sin.
explanation.definitionFit: A device is a tool or contrivance made for a particular purpose.

clue.text: A phone that is right for artist's studio

parts.note: tel is the short form of telephone
i.e. abbreviates id est, that is

explanation.surface: Instructions that a telephone line makes a painter's workroom just right.
explanation.definitionFit: An atelier is the workshop of an artist or designer, from the French word.

clue.text: Cold beer like this is rough!

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps
beer is flavoured with hops, so beer tastes like this: hoppy

explanation.surface: A drinker's verdict on a chilled ale: it's harsh stuff!
explanation.definitionFit: Choppy water is rough, broken by short irregular waves.

clue.text: Operate with risk in order to make political restructuring

indicators.note: put in order says the letters of the two words are arranged afresh

explanation.surface: Advice to act boldly and take chances to achieve reform.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in order' rearranges OPERATE and RISK together; 'with' and 'to make' only join.
explanation.definitionFit: Perestroika was Gorbachev's programme of economic and political reform in the Soviet Union.

clue.text: Court official to suffer in strike

indicators.note: in places the suffering word inside the striking word

parts.note: a biff is a blow or strike
to ail is to suffer illness

explanation.surface: A legal officer made to suffer during industrial action.
explanation.walkthrough: 'strike' looks like a walkout but is the blow BIFF.
explanation.definitionFit: A bailiff is a sheriff's officer who serves writs and seizes goods for the court.

clue.text: Building horrendous deficit mostly with the west of Europe

indicators.note: horrendous suggests something mangled, so the letters are jumbled
mostly means all but the last letter is kept
the west of a word written across is its leftmost letter

explanation.surface: A dreadful budget shortfall alongside western Europe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' drops the final T of DEFICIT; 'horrendous' turns DEFICI into EDIFIC, then E from Europe.
explanation.definitionFit: An edifice is a large, imposing structure.

clue.text: River flowing west through 26 wanting attention

indicators.note: the river runs through the city letters, so it sits inside them

parts.note: the answer to 26 is New York, abbreviated NY

indicators.note: in an across answer westward flow means reading right to left

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Wales, England and Scotland

explanation.surface: A river running west through New York needs looking after.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flowing west' turns DEE into EED, which runs 'through' NY.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone needy demands care or emotional support.

clue.text: Worry about god's creature of burden

indicators.note: about means the worry word goes around the god's name

parts.note: care is worry or anxiety
Thor is the Norse god of thunder

explanation.surface: Fretting over a deity's beast of burden.
explanation.definitionFit: A carthorse is a heavy draught horse bred for pulling loads.

clue.text: Basic principles of game obscure — sent off!

parts.note: RU is rugby union
dim means obscure or unclear

indicators.note: off signals the letters of sent are set awry

explanation.surface: A player gets a red card for an obscure rule of the game.
explanation.definitionFit: Rudiments are the first elements of a subject, its fundamentals.

clue.text: Beaten by one minute and seized

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
pounded means beaten repeatedly

explanation.surface: Losing by a minute, then having goods confiscated.
explanation.definitionFit: Goods impounded are taken into legal custody, as a car or evidence.

clue.text: Submitted, being dispatched across Italy

indicators.note: the sent word stretches across, around, the country letter

parts.note: being dispatched by mail is being posted
I is the international vehicle code for Italy

explanation.surface: Paperwork submitted while being sent over to Italy.
explanation.definitionFit: To posit is to put forward or propose as a basis for argument.

clue.text: Puts off a void game to steal the limelight

indicators.note: off says the letters of puts are knocked out of place
void means the word is emptied, leaving only its outer letters

explanation.surface: A cancelled match is postponed as someone hogs attention.
explanation.walkthrough: 'off' makes UPST of PUTS; 'void' empties GAME to GE.
explanation.definitionFit: To upstage is to divert attention from others onto oneself, as an actor moving upstage does.

clue.text: Stag full of energy and courage

indicators.note: full of means the deer word contains the next letter

parts.note: a hart is an adult male deer
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A lively, spirited stag.
explanation.definitionFit: Heart is used for courage or spirit, as in 'take heart'.

clue.text: Presently on the up, supporting firm secured by industry

indicators.note: in a down answer the supporting piece lies below the firm word

parts.note: hard means firm or solid

indicators.note: on the up in a down clue means read from bottom to top

parts.note: now means at present

explanation.surface: Business improving, backing a company won through hard industry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on the up' turns NOW into WON, placed under HARD.
explanation.definitionFit: Something hard-won was achieved only through great effort or diligence.

clue.text: Without taking sides, fancy short TV presenter

indicators.note: removing the sides of each word leaves only its inner letters

explanation.surface: A neutral broadcaster who fancies something brief.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Without taking sides' strips both ends from FANCY and SHORT, leaving ANC and HOR.
explanation.definitionFit: An anchor is the main presenter who links a news broadcast.

clue.text: Confronts son during exam retakes

indicators.note: during puts the son letter within the exam word

parts.note: resits are exams taken again

explanation.surface: A boy facing up to things while resitting exams.
explanation.definitionFit: To resist is to oppose or stand up against something.

clue.text: Wheat's second skin?

parts.note: a pelt is an animal skin

explanation.surface: Whether grain has another husk.
explanation.definitionFit: Spelt is an ancient species of grain related to common wheat.

clue.text: Kingdom of leather

definitions.meaning: a North African monarchy ruled from Rabat
fine goatskin leather used for bookbinding

explanation.surface: A realm famed for its hides.
explanation.definitionFit: The country is a kingdom, and its name is also given to soft goatskin leather tanned with sumac.

clue.text: More than enough as storage for gas

indicators.note: the phrase stores the answer inside its run of letters

explanation.surface: Plenty kept in reserve for fuel.
explanation.definitionFit: Ethane is a colourless hydrocarbon gas found in natural gas.

clue.text: City of north-east with unknown number in Labour

parts.note: NE is the compass abbreviation for north-east

indicators.note: in places the unknown inside the labour word

parts.note: labour is work
Y is an algebraic unknown

explanation.surface: A northern city whose Labour vote is uncertain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Labour' suggests the party but is just WORK.
explanation.definitionFit: New York is the largest city in the United States.

clue.text: Classified line of business?

parts.note: classified ads are small notices, so the trade selling them is a line of business

explanation.walkthrough: 'Classified' suggests secret, but it is the small ads section of a paper.
explanation.definitionFit: Advertising is the industry promoting products, including through classified notices.
